steps.title: 01-signin: Sign in to BookStack at http://127.0.0.1:8103/ using email admin@bench.local and password exactly {{env:APP_PASSWORD}}. Confirm that the authenticated interface is visible.
02-report: In the book {{01-signin.signed_in_user}} Handbook, identify and report the exact names of every page whose name starts with Seed:. Do not edit anything.

03-create: Create a BookStack page named exactly '{{runid}} Bench Page' whose rich-text body has one paragraph containing the literal runid {{runid}} and also a real heading titled Overview (not bold or paragraph text), and whose only tag is the existing tag name Review Status with value Approved. Save the page, then verify its saved content and tag; do not add a comment yet.

04-archive: Move the saved page '{{runid}} Bench Page' into the chapter '{{02-report.chapter_name_release_notes}}' in the book '{{03-create.book}}' (not the similarly named book or archive chapter). Verify the page's displayed book/chapter location after the move and report its URL slug.
05-verify: On the saved page '{{runid}} Bench Page', post exactly one comment that includes the literal runid {{runid}}. Verify the comment is visible and the page has exactly one comment.
